label_policy: REJECT explicit false source associations and known false claim meanings; UNCERTAIN when evidence does not qualify semantics; BLOCK when PIT unavailable; PIT_AVAILABLE permits evidence access only

cases.narrative: The consolidated revenue row displays its source value.
cases.rationale: An exact source observation is not financial-semantic approval.

cases.narrative: The parent-company revenue row displays its source value.
cases.rationale: A different reporting scope is still an unqualified source fact.

cases.narrative: Management reports an innovative-drug share of drug sales.
cases.rationale: The passage is attributed, not independently financially certified.

cases.narrative: The source reports a different amount.
cases.rationale: Claim value conflicts with the separately supplied source candidate.

cases.narrative: The amount belongs to the previous period.
cases.rationale: The quoted period header is not source-bound.

cases.narrative: The parent-company amount is described as consolidated.
cases.rationale: Reporting-statement type was substituted.

cases.narrative: The value is cited from a changed canonical document.
cases.rationale: The proposal no longer matches the source hash.

cases.narrative: A fabricated evidence ID supports the amount.
cases.rationale: The asserted evidence ID does not exist in the source packet.

cases.narrative: The source observation is certified as share of consolidated revenue.
cases.rationale: The claim inserts a semantic identity absent from the source candidate.

cases.narrative: The difference between consolidated and parent revenues is year-on-year growth.
cases.rationale: Two different statement scopes cannot form a period comparison.

cases.narrative: The same evidence is cited as two independent periods.
cases.rationale: Duplicated claim evidence is not independent.

cases.narrative: Two observations of the same period are presented as a period change.
cases.rationale: The candidate financial period endpoints are identical.

cases.narrative: Innovative-drug sales were 60% of total consolidated company revenue.
cases.rationale: Synthetic source explicitly identifies the denominator as drug sales, not consolidated revenue. Narrative-only false assertion; gate may abstain.

cases.narrative: Total consolidated company revenue grew 10% year over year.
cases.rationale: Synthetic source states growth only for innovative-drug sales. Narrative-only false assertion; gate may abstain.

cases.narrative: Innovative-drug sales growth caused total company profits to increase.
cases.rationale: Causal account is unsupported but not independently falsified by this source packet; must not admit.

cases.narrative: Compare last year's and this year's reported revenue.
cases.rationale: Matching candidate metrics in different documents still need accounting comparability review.

cases.narrative: Management execution explains an improvement in margins.
cases.rationale: Untyped narrative is not qualified or endorsed.

cases.narrative: Management reports growth for innovative-drug sales specifically.
cases.rationale: An attributed observation does not certify broader company performance.

cases.narrative: Source packet contains duplicate evidence identifiers.
cases.rationale: Cannot establish a unique source packet; fail closed without pretending it is a false narrative.

cases.narrative: Attempt to access a source on its publication calendar day.
cases.rationale: Date-level PIT rule makes announcement-day data usable only the next day.

cases.narrative: Check source availability on the next calendar day.
cases.rationale: Availability is not approval of financial meaning or publication.
